source: in-situ 3D PSF (psf3d, 2026-11-11) of /mnt/data/dmdsf/bn_dnapaint/dnapaint/0.5nM/cover1/1/simflux_5.5ms_500mW.tif: fit_insitu2 on its own isolated tracks (frames < 30000), Zernike 5-21 + focus + line blur, then frozen + per-pattern-angle traceless blur (angle_delta); camera / pattern blocks copied from calib_0.5nM.json [ALTERNATIVE: per-angle traceless blur instead of photoselection; the recommended calib is the file without _ad]

camera.note: gain 0.56 confirmed by robust (trimmed) var-vs-level fit (0.552); read noise 0.9 e (robust fit; in-situ 1.9 absorbed model error); per-pixel maps in analysis/camera_maps_0.5nM.npz

pattern.steps: frame%6; angle=step//3; I = A*relint*(1+depth*cos(k.r - phase - dphi(t))), r=(x=col,y=row) px
pattern.depth_note: 0.925/0.955: cross-cycle estimator, nn_overlap>=3 subset (real 0.920-0.927 / 0.953-0.954); bench v2 shows this subset within ~+0.02 of truth (worker, 2026-11-08). step_fit regression depth is diluted and must not be written to pattern files.

psf3d.note: image-plane blur covariance px^2 [sxx, syy, sxy] (VectorialPSF.blur); psf_dipole_M_angle = emission-dipole tensor per pattern angle (frame % 6 // 3), M_a = (1 - gamma) diag((1 - zeta)/2, (1 - zeta)/2, zeta) + gamma e_a e_a^T; see docs/PSF_POLARIZATION.md
